users: students and instructors using MEEG machine-learning tutorial materials
supported_tasks: teach regression, image classification, clustering, and sequence regression
not_intended_for: a validated predictor for a new physical system, a claim that course dataset results generalize, or reuse of external datasets without their terms and citations

required_inputs: tutorial-specific datasets and external-data access where stated

limitations: Tutorial tasks describe learning objectives and do not independently establish experimental heat-flux, CHF, or forecasting accuracy.
Some referenced datasets are externally hosted and retain separate rights and access conditions.
